newsitem.title: HONDURAS: Honduran envoy to seek freedom of Peru ambassador.
newsitem.headline: Honduran envoy to seek freedom of Peru ambassador.

text.p: The Honduran foreign minister said on Monday he would travel to Peru Tuesday in a bid to seek freedom for the Honduran ambassador to Peru, who is among the 83 hostages being held by leftist guerrillas.

The Honduran ambassador, Eduardo Martell, was among the dignitaries seized by Tupac Amaru Revolutionary Movement guerrillas during a gala cocktail party at the Japanese ambassador's residence in Lima on Dec. 17.

Delmer Urbizo, the foreign minister of Honduras, said he was going to Peru "to be closer to the people in the government of Peru, with representatives of the Japanese government and other sectors that are intervening in the freedom of hostages."
